text:
Rina: Quick idea 1: Build a 20m "Quickstart + MiniBench" livestream for the OSS Starter Kit. One repo, 2 runnable examples, tiny benchmark CSV, and an on-demand highlight clip. Timing: 20m demo + 10m Q.
Omar: Love it. Audience = tinkering devs and infra curious PMs. Keep the repo ultra-small: README, chat example, embed example, bench script.
Felix: Lead capture: email + role + company size dropdown. Gate lightly. HubSpot mapping needed. Who will draft the field list?
June: Bench narrative: show baseline vs "kit-tuned" (batching + kv caching + int8). Metrics to call out: p50, p95, tokens/sec, and $/1k tokens. Small CSV and a 1-para explainer.
Rina: Assign: Omar -> repo + clip; June -> bench runs + CSV + tiny chart; Felix -> HS form + routing; I'll write the blog intro + event page. Design request for hero/thumb.
Omar: Draft social copy: "20m Quickstart: Wire the OSS Starter Kit and see a tiny benchmark. Live Tue 11am PT. Repo + CSV on-demand. Register: https://go.redwood/quickkit". Thoughts?
Felix: For HubSpot: listId=49920, hidden lead_source=quickkit_2026, utm_campaign=quickkit_launch. Automations: non-enterprise -> 2-email nurture; enterprise -> AE-alert + tag quickkit_enterprise.
June: Benchmark commands for reproducibility (to be added to bench/README):
```bash
# baseline
python bench/run.py --model small --batch 1 --quant none --iters 120
# kit-tuned
python bench/run.py --model small --batch 6 --quant int8 --kv_cache true --iters 120
```
I'll export p50/p95 and cost/1k tokens to bench/results.csv.
Rina: Can we add a 2-line CTA code snippet in the email? small example:```python
from redwood import Client
print(Client().generate("summarize: 'short'"))
```
Keeps it tangible and copy-pasteable.
Omar: I'll prep a 90s highlight clip after the recording and a 3-line blog blurb linking the repo + CSV. Will schedule social 24h, 1h, 10m.
Felix: Routing specifics: add tag quickkit_2026 to all registrants; if company_size==enterprise -> ownerRotation=ae-team and add to SDR queue; add automation: click "download CSV" -> tag engaged_hot.
Rina: Hero image: @design please make a compact 1200x600 hero + a 5s animated thumb for the highlight.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Quickstart + MiniBench: OSS Starter Kit" Tue 11:00 PT 1d, 1h reminders.
June: Recommend we publish the CSV and a tiny Jupyter notebook so folks can verify. That increases trust.
Omar: I'll drop the draft repo link once it's live. Need the final HS URL from Felix before we push email.
Felix: I'll create the HubSpot form today and paste canonical URL + field mapping here. Hidden fields populated.
Rina: Final checklist: repo & clip (Omar), bench CSV + notebook (June), HS form + routing (Felix), hero/thumb (design), blog + page (Rina). Ping here when done. :rocket:
